evals.name: syntax-error-stops-the-page
evals.prompt: I wrote notes.md with a flowchart in it. Check the mermaid before I turn it into a local HTML page. Line 2 of the block is `A[Start --> B`.
evals.expected_output: Runs the gate on notes.md, reports the failing block with file, line and error text, and does not write the page until the diagram is fixed.
expectations: Runs the bundled mermaid-gate.mjs through node on the file
Reports the block's file, line and error text from the JSON report
Does not write the HTML page while a block has status error

evals.name: no-mmdc-keeps-source-and-says-why
evals.prompt: Pre-render the mermaid diagrams in design.md to SVG for a local page. mmdc is not installed on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Runs the gate with --svg-dir, sees render source with a reason, keeps the Mermaid source in the page with the reason printed beside it, and does not call the page rendered.
expectations: Keeps the Mermaid source in the page and prints the report's reason beside it
Does not install mmdc or describe the page as pre-rendered

evals.name: artifact-needs-parse-only
evals.prompt: I am publishing this sequence diagram as an Artifact. Make sure the mermaid parses first.
evals.expected_output: Runs the gate without --svg-dir and publishes the diagram as Mermaid source, since an Artifact renders it natively.
expectations: Does not embed an SVG for the Artifact
Proceeds only when no block has status error
